title: Co-Provider Charges for Procedures at Riverbend — Medical Hardship Costs
content:
**Clause.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), co-providers' charges are added to the qualifying medical debt documented with the other medical costs in one of three ways:
1. when the patient's Good Faith & Price Estimates self-pay good faith estimate for a procedure with co-providers has its service completed or is in dispute (an estimate whose service has been completed before one in dispute and, among several of the same status, the estimate listed first among the patient's estimates) and no outside medical bills document has been logged as received on the case, the anesthesia, pathology and radiology lines of its current version are added;
2. otherwise, when the patient's Outpatient Surgery package estimate has its service completed (the estimate listed first among the patient's estimates when several are) and no outside medical bills document has been logged as received on the case, the co-provider lines (anesthesia, pathology and radiology) of its current version are added;
3. otherwise nothing is added for co-providers.

**Truth table.**

| Procedure-with-co-providers estimate completed or in dispute | Outpatient Surgery package completed | Outside medical bills logged as received on the case | Added |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | either | no | its anesthesia, pathology and radiology lines |
| no | yes | no | the package's co-provider lines |
| no | no | no | nothing |
| either | either | yes | nothing |

Hypothetical: anesthesia 600.00, pathology 150.00, radiology 250.00 on the current version of a completed co-provider estimate; 1,000.00 is added.
